summary: Elevra Lithium furnished a 6-K with an ASX announcement confirming completion of the sale of all its rights and interests in the Ewoyaa Lithium Project in Ghana, including spodumene offtake rights, to Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt for US$71 million cash before fees and taxes. Completion followed Ghanaian Government approvals; the transaction was announced 11 May 2026 and updated 1 October 2026. Elevra sheds development funding obligations and refocuses on North American assets. Huayou's separate acquisition of Atlantic Lithium, holder of the remaining private-sector interest, is not a condition to this sale. Watch integration of proceeds and any residual project liabilities.
